# bcpack-gpu-hlsl — AI Agent & Code-Search Entrypoint (`v0.11.0`)

> Open 4K AAA Streaming Benchmark, 12.41M Mesh-Shader Showcase, & 19-Test Verification Suite (`MIT OR Apache-2.0`), powered by the standalone hardware SDK [`POMXARK/bcpack-gpu-sdk`](https://github.com/POMXARK/bcpack-gpu-sdk) mounted as a Git submodule at `sdk/`.

## Standalone Hardware SDK (`sdk/` -> `https://github.com/POMXARK/bcpack-gpu-sdk`)
- C/C++ Zero-Copy Integration API: `sdk/include/bcpack_gpu.h`, `sdk/src/ffi.rs`, `sdk/examples/directstorage_hook.cpp`
- Wave32 GPU BCPack Kernels: `sdk/shaders/bcpack_decode.hlsl`, `sdk/shaders/bcpack_bc7_rans.hlsl`, `sdk/shaders/bc16_pack.hlsl`
- Gfx10 Swizzle -> Linear Detile: `sdk/shaders/gfx10_detile.hlsl`
- Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V Outputs & Build Script: `sdk/shaders/compile_spirv.sh`, `sdk/shaders/spirv/*.spv`
- Virtual Descriptor Pager: `sdk/src/descriptor_paging.rs`, `sdk/shaders/bindless_paging.hlsl`
- GPU Crowd Skinning, Hi-Z, VRS Tier 2 & Compute RayQuery RTGI: `sdk/src/crowd_skinning.rs`, `sdk/shaders/{crowd_skin,hiz_build,hiz_cull,aaa_vrs,aaa_rtgi_cs}.hlsl`
- SDK AI Docs: `sdk/llms.txt`, `sdk/docs/AI_ARCHITECTURE.md`, `sdk/docs/INTEGRATION_GUIDE.md`

## Search Keywords / Problems Solved
- Xbox Series X|S `BCPack` / `IDStorageQueueX` / `dstorage` CPU decompression bottleneck (~40 MB/s -> 5 FPS)
- NVIDIA DX12 `E_OUTOFMEMORY` on `D3D12_DESCRIPTOR_HEAP_FLAG_SHADER_VISIBLE` (~1M descriptor limit) -> `ResourceDescriptorHeap[]` Virtual Paging (`1.25M` virtual IDs -> `262,144` physical slots in `0.064 ms`)
- DXC 1.8 `-O3` bug with `WavePrefixCountBits` + `WaveActiveCountBits` in HLSL Wave32 -> `WaveActiveBallot` + `countbits` fix
- NVIDIA RTX 5080 Driver `621.24` flickering 8x8 black squares under DXR 1.1 `RayQuery` + Async Compute -> TLAS rebuild `uav_barrier_all()` isolation fix
- AMD Gfx10 / RDNA2 hardware swizzle `SW_64KB_D` / `SW_4KB_S` -> GPU Compute detile (`432.6 GB/s`)
- Zero-copy DX12 C-ABI texture upload (`bcpack_gpu_create_from_device`, `BcPackDecodeToBuffer`, `BcPackDecodeToTexture2D`)
- HLSL SM 6.6 -> Vulkan 1.3 SPIR-V (`dxc -spirv -fspv-target-env=vulkan1.3`, `VK_EXT_subgroup_size_control`)
- GPU Sampler Feedback Streaming (`g_SfsFeedback` + `ResourceMinLODClamp` saving `118.5-151.0 MiB` VRAM live) + anti-thrash hysteresis
- Low-VRAM 8GB GPU scaling (`--preset auto|low|medium|ultra`, `IDXGIAdapter3::QueryVideoMemoryInfo`): `50%/67%/100%` Catmull-Rom TAAU upscaler (`aaa_taa.hlsl`), Xbox/RDNA2-style Compute `RayQuery` RTGI (`aaa_rtgi_cs.hlsl`, `aaa_rtgi_cs.spv` `VK_KHR_ray_query`, `196.8 FPS` Ultra / `258.9 FPS` +VRS), & Hardware VRS Tier 2 (`aaa_vrs.hlsl`, `aaa_vrs.spv`)
- Hardware Mesh Shaders (`as_6_5`/`ms_6_5`) + 6-Mip Conservative Hi-Z Occlusion Culling (`12.41M -> 0.99M` tris)

- C/C++ Zero-Copy Integration API: `include/bcpack_gpu.h`, `src/ffi.rs`

- Hi-Z + Mesh Shaders + 500-NPC Crowd + Active SFS + TAA/AgX Showcase: `src/aaa_scene.rs`, `src/aaa_world.rs`, `shaders/aaa_*.hlsl`
- Target Translation Layer Integration Notes: `docs/OUTREACH_PITCH.md`

## Verified Hardware Results (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080, DX12 Debug Layer Clean — 0 Errors)
- `bcpack-gpu-demo.exe --verify`: `19/19 PASS` (`0` byte/symbol mismatches vs `Ahmet-Dedeler/bcpack-rs`)
- BC1 4K-Tiled Decode: `11,327.6 MB/s` (`5.650 ms` / `64 MiB`, `282.1x` vs 1T CPU)
- BC7 16-Lane rANS (`32/32` Wave32): `6,024.0 MB/s equiv` (`5.312 ms` / `32 MiB`, `247.1x` vs 1T CPU)
- Gfx10 `SW_64KB_D` Detile: `432.6 GB/s` (`0.144 ms` / `64 MiB`)
- Virtual Descriptor Paging (`1.25M -> 262K`): `0.064 ms` (`65,536` verified pixel samples, `0` mismatches)
- Live 60s Open AAA Benchmark (`1920x1080` HDR): `150.61 FPS Avg` (`1% Low 87.07 FPS`, `86.2 / 204.7 MiB` SFS VRAM)
